record.segments: Downtown city office 1871 to Mar 1915; Abbe Observatory Apr 1915 to Mar 1947; CVG airport from Apr 1947 (identical to CVG from then on)
record.name: Cincinnati Area

items.label: Preliminary observation
items.head: Record rain on Nov 26
items.body: 2.16 in broke the Nov 26 record of 1.49 in set in 1946, a record 80 years old, by 0.67 in.
items.copyFact: Cincinnati's 2.16 in of rain on November 26, 2026 broke the Nov 26 record of 1.49 in set in 1946 (preliminary data).

evidence.sample: 155 prior years with an observation, none missing

items.label: Preliminary observation
items.head: 2nd wettest Thanksgiving on record
items.body: 2.16 in on Thanksgiving, Nov 26. Only 2010 (2.62 in) was wetter, ranked against each year's own Thanksgiving date since 1871.
items.copyFact: Thanksgiving 2026 was Cincinnati's 2nd wettest on record, behind only 2010 (preliminary).

evidence.sample: 156 Thanksgivings with an observation, none missing; 1939, 1940, 1941 dates varied by state, and the ranking is the same for every candidate date

items.label: Frequency · 2026 preliminary
items.head: 2 inches on Thanksgiving is rare
items.body: Only 2 of 156 Thanksgivings since 1871 had at least 2 inches (2010 and 2026), 1.3% in this record. Before 2026, 1 of 155.
items.copyFact: Only two Cincinnati Thanksgivings since 1871 have had at least 2 inches of rain: 2010 and 2026.

evidence.sample: 156 Thanksgivings with an observation; historical frequency, not a probability

items.label: Preliminary observation
items.head: 4th wettest November day on record
items.body: Only November 5, 1948 (3.28 in), November 25, 2010 (2.62 in) and November 3, 2011 (2.26 in) were wetter. The last day of any month with this much rain was July 20, 2025 (2.94 in).
items.copyFact: Cincinnati's 2.16 in on November 26, 2026 was its 4th wettest November day on record (preliminary).

evidence.sample: 4036 November days with a measurable observation

items.short: 4.34 in so far, 157% of normal to date.
items.label: Preliminary observation
items.head: November is running wet
items.body: 4.34 in through the 26th, 1.57 in above normal to date (157%). Already more than a normal full November (3.23 in).
items.copyFact: Cincinnati's November is 1.57 inches above normal through the 26th (preliminary).

evidence.source: Cincinnati Area (official city record, CVGthr); normals 1991-2020
evidence.sample: 155 years with a complete November 1 to 26
